pity.title: Pity calculator
pity.intro: Pick the equipment, its current level and your pity counter to see the most you could spend.
pity.counter.hint: Failed attempts accumulated on this upgrade.
pity.assume: Worst-case calculation: probabilities are ignored. With a pity of n, attempt n+1 is a guaranteed success; with counter 0 and pity 3, the maximum is 4 attempts. Steps with no pity or 100% success count as 1 attempt.
support.epicHint: Click the Epic button to copy my creator code and use it at checkout on the Epic Games Store.
pet.title: Pet AFK Arena
pet.intro: Tick the pets you own (level 99) and how many copies of each. The calculator finds the expedition split that gives the most acorns per day.
pet.rules: Rules used: 3 expedition slots at once; each slot runs one 24 h expedition or two 12 h ones in a row, and they can be repeated with the same team. The same campaign with the same duration can't run twice at once. Max 5 pets per team and a pet can't be in two expeditions at once. The required power is the sum of the power of the pets sent.
pet.none: Tick at least one pet to calculate.
pet.twice: sent twice a day (12 h + 12 h)
pet.nofeasible: With the ticked pets no expedition can be completed. Tick more pets or more copies.
pet.approx: The search was cut short by time: a better split may exist.
pet.tip: Tip: don't tick the pets you don't want to keep busy. Pets on an AFK Arena expedition can't accompany you or be summoned in the Celestial Spire.
pet.tip2: My personal recommendation: Aurus for farming (it gives a 10% buff and tanks), Lumi for TS and expeditions (the single-player mode that you play yourself; it has nothing to do with AFK Arena) and Sleepy Koala for raids. If you want to keep them for those uses, don't tick them in the calculator: a pet on an AFK Arena expedition can't be used in other modes.
